answer: Picture admission priced in a capped, openly-traded token as scarce as saffron: each identity must burn a fixed amount to enroll, then a small amount every epoch to stay live. One honest agent buys its burn quietly, but an attacker minting a dune of clones must buy N times the token on a thin market, and each purchase bids the price up, so the total bill climbs faster than N: a superlinear cost that snaps the thread a sybil fleet hangs by, since any identity that stops burning is dropped as dead.
